items.name: libx264
items.summary: Software H.264 encoder. It gives small files and wide player support.

items.name: libx265
items.summary: Software HEVC encoder. It gives smaller files than H.264 at the same quality.

items.name: libvpx-vp9
items.summary: Software VP9 encoder for WebM files.

items.name: libsvtav1
items.summary: Scalable AV1 encoder with good speed.

items.name: gif
items.summary: GIF encoder with a limited 256-color palette.

items.name: aac
items.summary: Native AAC encoder. It is stable and widely supported.

items.name: libopus
items.summary: Opus encoder for WebM and Ogg files.

items.name: pcm_s16le
items.summary: Uncompressed 16-bit PCM audio. It is lossless and large.
